notes.title: New build system
notes.content: [h2]🛠️ Improvements:[/h2][list][*][p]Due to repeated feedback about the building system, I've made some adjustments. The old build menu still exists, and I’ll likely add an option to choose which one you prefer. Please let me know what you think of the new system! 🙂 (In the future, I’ll implement camera movement when the mouse is moved to the edge of the screen.)[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371533/a064e2e5045a08db3289f84fbf2cc29ff5b9b318.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]When you now select a building, it follows the mouse. Once placed, you can continue placing more of the same type. A second left-click confirms placement. Right-click takes you back one step or exits the build menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]🐞 Bugfixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Attacking was no longer possible because units were assigned to the wrong object.[/p][/*][*][p]For the same reason, placed units weren’t returned to the player after exiting attack preparation—they were stored instead.[/p][/*][*][p]If a quarry was placed at the bottom edge of the map, workers couldn’t reach it because the area was outside the playable terrain. A piece of terrain has now been added there.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371533/77cc954a4196ce82ecd68693909cfb99514e739e.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]I'll be on vacation for a week starting tomorrow and won't be able to respond to feedback during that time, so please be patient. 🙂[/h3]

tags.feature: The old build menu still exists, and I’ll likely add an option to choose which one you prefer. Please let me know what you think of the new system! 🙂 (In the future, I’ll implement camera movement when the mouse is moved to the edge of the screen.)

When you now select a building, it follows the mouse. Once placed, you can continue placing more of the same type. A second left-click confirms placement. Right-click takes you back one step or exits the build menu.

tags.bug: Attacking was no longer possible because units were assigned to the wrong object.
For the same reason, placed units weren’t returned to the player after exiting attack preparation—they were stored instead.
If a quarry was placed at the bottom edge of the map, workers couldn’t reach it because the area was outside the playable terrain. A piece of terrain has now been added there.

notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.content: [h2]🐞 [b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It was no longer possible to build walls[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy units sometimes appeared red at the start of a battle and stayed that way[/p][/*][*][p]Clay pits could no longer snap together[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mage projectiles simply disappeared when placed on walls[/p][/*][*][p]If the player was still in the building menu when a battle started, the buttons remained visible[/p][/*][*][p]When sending a merchant to a resource, the button didn’t disappear. Pressing it again caused an error[/p][/*][*][p]When trying to move a building, the rest of the UI remained active[/p][/*][*][p]If a building was completed while the player was under attack, it appeared in the overworld after the next load instead of in the village[/p][/*][/list][h2]⚖️ [b]Balancing:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]AI now “thinks” significantly slower, giving the player more time overall[/p][/*][*][p]Defense bonus of walls and towers has been increased[/p][/*][*][p]The number of peasants spawned per skill point increased from 1 to 3[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant movement speed has been doubled[/p][/*][*][p]Peasants are now slightly more durable[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mages now deal less damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]AIs can now only send armies every few minutes — a random interval between 3 and 6 minutes[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: It was no longer possible to build walls
Enemy units sometimes appeared red at the start of a battle and stayed that way
Clay pits could no longer snap together
Fire mage projectiles simply disappeared when placed on walls
If the player was still in the building menu when a battle started, the buttons remained visible
When sending a merchant to a resource, the button didn’t disappear. Pressing it again caused an error
When trying to move a building, the rest of the UI remained active
If a building was completed while the player was under attack, it appeared in the overworld after the next load instead of in the village

tags.balance_change: AI now “thinks” significantly slower, giving the player more time overall
Defense bonus of walls and towers has been increased
The number of peasants spawned per skill point increased from 1 to 3
Merchant movement speed has been doubled
Peasants are now slightly more durable
Fire mages now deal less damage to buildings
AIs can now only send armies every few minutes — a random interval between 3 and 6 minutes

notes.title: Small improvements and bugfixes
notes.content: [h2]🛠️ [b]Improvements:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It's now easier to select units placed on walls[/p][/*][*][p]Placing units on walls has been slightly improved[/p][/*][*][p]The castle icon will now wiggle while the player is under attack[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🐞 [b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]After units took damage, not all colors were correctly reset[/p][/*][*][p]When a wall or tower was destroyed during combat and a unit was standing on it, the unit now dies instead of floating[/p][/*][*][p]Fire mages were unable to recognize towers as buildings[/p][/*][*][p]When moving a wall with a unit on top, the unit would remain floating in the air[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]⚖️ [b]Balancing:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]AI opponents can now only have one attack army at a time to prevent overwhelming the player in the endgame[/p][/*][*][p]AIs now use fewer archers during attacks[/p][/*][*][p]All melee units are now more durable[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - After units took damage, not all colors were correctly reset
- When a wall or tower was destroyed during combat and a unit was standing on it, the unit now dies instead of floating
- Fire mages were unable to recognize towers as buildings
- When moving a wall with a unit on top, the unit would remain floating in the air

tags.balance_change: - AI opponents can now only have one attack army at a time to prevent overwhelming the player in the endgame
- AIs now use fewer archers during attacks
- All melee units are now more durable

notes.title: Info buttons and bug fixes
notes.content: [h2]🛠️ [b]Improvements:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Tooltips are now available for all buildings and all units.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371533/7eb3d26a98dd602f85cb09f68f65de1223688054.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The easiest difficulty level has been made slightly easier.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It was possible to speed up game time by repeatedly pressing Pause and Play.[/p][/*][*][p]Villagers no longer drop into negative numbers when popularity is low.[/p][/*][*][p]It was not possible to place multiple clay pits next to each other, even though it appeared to be allowed.[/p][/*][*][p]If food rations were set to -5 and the game was reloaded, they were reset to 0.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Tooltips are now available for all buildings and all units.

tags.balance_change: The easiest difficulty level has been made slightly easier.

tags.bug: It was possible to speed up game time by repeatedly pressing Pause and Play.
Villagers no longer drop into negative numbers when popularity is low.
It was not possible to place multiple clay pits next to each other, even though it appeared to be allowed.
If food rations were set to -5 and the game was reloaded, they were reset to 0.

notes.title: Bugfixes and balancing
notes.content: [h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]In castle view, if no path was available, units could no longer be placed during an attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Units were made narrower to better fit through tight corridors.[/p][/*][*][p]Workers are now teleported back to the storage after a while if they have no path.[/p][/*][*][p]If a trade was canceled, the button wasn’t hidden, and pressing it again caused an error.[/p][/*][*][p]If a merchant returned to the castle after a canceled trade, they were counted twice for the player.[/p][/*][*][p]It was possible to need a negative amount of merchants which then got added to the players merchants.[/p][/*][*][p]If the skill UI was still open while being attacked, it remained open and allowed unintended actions 🙂[/p][/*][*][p]Armies and merchants could no longer find the player's city after loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowering the sound slider to halfway made the audio so quiet it was barely audible (this may affect existing settings).[/p][/*][*][p]Workers should no longer stand in front of the storage and do their working animation after loading[/p][/*][*][p]After pausing and unpausing the game was running faster in the background[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ Balancing Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Merchants now costs 35 gold instead of 100.[/p][/*][*][p]The market now costs 100 gold instead of 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Stables now require 10 less wood and stone.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls and towers now provide significantly more defense bonus to units stationed on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Bakers now require more wheat but produce more bread per work cycle.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other changes:[/h3][list][*][p]The quarríes will now be placed further appart from each other by default[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: In castle view, if no path was available, units could no longer be placed during an attack.
Units were made narrower to better fit through tight corridors.
Workers are now teleported back to the storage after a while if they have no path.
If a trade was canceled, the button wasn’t hidden, and pressing it again caused an error.
If a merchant returned to the castle after a canceled trade, they were counted twice for the player.
It was possible to need a negative amount of merchants which then got added to the players merchants.
If the skill UI was still open while being attacked, it remained open and allowed unintended actions 🙂
Armies and merchants could no longer find the player's city after loading the game.
Lowering the sound slider to halfway made the audio so quiet it was barely audible (this may affect existing settings).
Workers should no longer stand in front of the storage and do their working animation after loading
After pausing and unpausing the game was running faster in the background

tags.balance_change: Merchants now costs 35 gold instead of 100.
The market now costs 100 gold instead of 200.
Stables now require 10 less wood and stone.
Walls and towers now provide significantly more defense bonus to units stationed on them.
Bakers now require more wheat but produce more bread per work cycle.

notes.title: Bug fixes and small improvements
notes.content: [h3]🔧 Adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]The cost of the church has been reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Buttons for recruiting units and accessing the skill tree are now also available in the castle view[/p][/*][*][p]Mages now deal less damage to buildings[/p][/*][*][p]A sound effect now plays when research is completed[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes in the Last Two Versions:[/h3][list][*][p]Win and Lose screen buttons were not working[/p][/*][*][p]A crash occurred when an army had a negative player index[/p][/*][*][p]There was a ghost town with a negative player index[/p][/*][*][p]Workers sometimes got so heavily congested at the storage area that they couldn’t move away[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally, skill configurations failed to load correctly, resetting everything back to zero[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to Kekskiller for reporting these issues :)[/p]

tags.balance_change: The cost of the church has been reduced

tags.feature: Buttons for recruiting units and accessing the skill tree are now also available in the castle view

tags.balance_change: Mages now deal less damage to buildings

tags.feature: A sound effect now plays when research is completed

tags.bug: Win and Lose screen buttons were not working
A crash occurred when an army had a negative player index
There was a ghost town with a negative player index
Workers sometimes got so heavily congested at the storage area that they couldn’t move away
Occasionally, skill configurations failed to load correctly, resetting everything back to zero
